title: A merchant-issued refund on a loan NOT charged off posts 64.26 to LOAN_PORTFOLIO 7 then 2.15 to INTEREST_RECEIVABLE 4, then ONE 66.41 debit to the resolved fund source 10 (loan 15 L86, principal+interest)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a MERCHANT-ISSUED REFUND posted on a loan NOT charged off under the SAME method as an ordinary repayment, createJournalEntriesForLoanRepayments (dispatch: isRepaymentType() includes isMerchantIssuedRefund() [LoanTransactionType.java:193-196]; AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:87-90 then :1369-1376; pinned 426a23544). Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP2_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL, loan 15 chargedOff false / fraud false) at merchantIssuedRefund transaction L86. request.repayment_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's transaction id 86 (type loanTransactionType.merchantIssuedRefund id 21, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 8 AUTOPAY, manuallyReversed false): principalPortion 64.26 -> "6426" minor units and interestPortion 2.15 -> "215" minor units, fee/penalty/overpayment 0 and omitted. request.repayment_journal.accounts is the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP2_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL.json with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel: loanPortfolioAccountId 7, receivableInterest/Fee/PenaltyAccountId 4, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, fundSourceAccountId 10; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so the refund's paymentType 8 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 10. The vector supplies the RESOLVED account; the port does not resolve channels. expect.repayment_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the three L86 legs in id order from the journal-entries SWEEP: leg id 224 CREDIT glAccountId 7 64.26, leg id 225 CREDIT glAccountId 4 2.15, leg id 226 DEBIT glAccountId 10 66.41. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a repayment-type posting CREDITS each non-zero portion to its slot account in slot order (principal then interest), MERGING portions that share a credit account at the first slot's position, then DEBITs the total exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source, credits first and the single debit last. A port that credits the wrong slot account, reorders the credits, or debits an account other than the resolved fund source moves a leg. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: the merge discriminator (principal 7 and interest 4 resolve to DISTINCT accounts, so no two portions merge; the loan-1 interest+penalty merge vector grades it); the transaction-type dispatch itself (the seam carries no transaction type, so the merchant-issued kind is established by the capture, not by an input the port branches on). It DOES grade the one-debit-vs-debit-per-portion discriminator: with two credits, a port that debits per credit posts two 10-account debits, 6426 and 215, instead of the oracle's one 6641 debit. Every leg in the sweep file for L86 is transcribed; the ids are the observed posting ids and no reversed mirror leg is present. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
